post.summary:
SubmitVersion validates a payload and, unless dry_run is set, stores it as a
new immutable version.

CreateRelease starts a rollout. With dry_run it returns the plan and writes
nothing.

get.summary:
GetRingProjection returns, per ring, the desired version and its signed
envelope. Used by sinks such as the Kubernetes controller.

post.summary:
KillSwitch immediately returns every ring of a target to its previous
known-good version and freezes the target. Break-glass, audited.

expectedRing.description:
Ring the caller believes is active. -1 or unset+has_expected=false skips
the check.

override.description:
Skip gate and bake requirements. Requires the break-glass role and a
reason; audited as an override.

environments.description:
Environments this version may be delivered to. Empty means every
environment of the config at submission time.

v1ApplyState.description:
- APPLY_STATE_APPLIED: Verified and durably stored by the agent; not yet accepted by the SDK.
 - APPLY_STATE_ACCEPTED: The application's parser accepted it and it is being served.
 - APPLY_STATE_REJECTED: The application's parser rejected it; last-known-good is being served.
 - APPLY_STATE_FAILED: The agent could not verify or store it; nothing changed locally.
 - APPLY_STATE_CRASH_LOOP: The application crash-looped on it; it was quarantined.

detail.description: JSON object with action-specific detail. Never payload content.

reachable.description: Of those, seen within the reachable window.

applied.description: Reported APPLIED or better for the current generation and version.

accepted.description: Reported ACCEPTED for the current generation and version.

environments.description:
Rollout policy per environment. A config can only be released to
environments listed here.

retainVersions.description: Committed versions kept per config beyond those still referenced.

before.description: Compact JSON; truncated for large values.

v1FailureMode.description:
- FAILURE_MODE_FAIL_STATIC: Keep serving last-known-good when the source is unreachable or stale.
 - FAILURE_MODE_FAIL_CLOSED: Mark the snapshot unusable once it is older than max_staleness.

v1FinalStage.description:
- FINAL_STAGE_HOLDOUT: The last ring ends below 100%; the remainder is a holdout that stays on
the baseline as control and converts when the release completes.
 - FINAL_STAGE_HARD_THRESHOLDS_ONLY: The last ring is 100%: no concurrent control exists, so only hard
thresholds and SDK evidence apply to it.

metric.description:
Counter of all events (RATIO), histogram base name (HISTOGRAM_OVER) or
event counter (INSTANCE_EVENT).

le.description: Bucket boundary, exactly as exported in the "le" label (HISTOGRAM_OVER).

margin.description: Tolerated absolute degradation of the proportion (non-inferiority margin).

hardMax.description:
Roll back when the canary proportion is at or above this, regardless of
control. 0 disables.

minEvents.description: Minimum total events per cohort before the metric can be evaluated.

v1GateMode.description:
- GATE_MODE_PROMETHEUS: Prometheus-backed canary/control comparison.
 - GATE_MODE_NONE: No metric gate: convergence, bake time and SDK evidence only. Promotion
then requires an operator.

minBake.description: Minimum time a ring stays exposed before the first look.

looks.description: Number of predeclared looks. Error probability is split across them.

maxControlProportion.description:
The comparison is INCONCLUSIVE when the control cohort's own proportion
for any metric is above this. 0 disables.

reason.description: Short machine-readable reason, never payload content.

servingVersion.description: What the application is actually serving.

maxBytes.description: Maximum payload size in bytes. Required, at most the server limit.

maxDepth.description: Maximum JSON nesting depth. 0 means the server default (64).

maxItems.description:
Cardinality limits: a JSON pointer to an array or object and its maximum
number of elements, e.g. {"/features": 200}.

v1MetricKind.description:
- METRIC_KIND_RATIO: bad_metric / total_metric, both counters.
 - METRIC_KIND_HISTOGRAM_OVER: Fraction of observations above a bucket boundary of a histogram.
 - METRIC_KIND_INSTANCE_EVENT: Fraction of instances whose counter increased (e.g. restarts).

members.description: Current members hashed or pinned into exactly this ring.

expectedRevision.description: When set, update only if the stored revision matches.

maxSizeRatio.description: Reject when size > max_size_ratio * previous size. 0 disables.

minSizeRatio.description: Reject when size < min_size_ratio * previous size. 0 disables.

maxItemsRatio.description:
Per JSON pointer: reject when the item count grows by more than this
factor relative to the base version.

minItemsRatio.description: Per JSON pointer: reject when the item count shrinks below this fraction.

activeRing.description: Index of the highest ring exposed to the candidate; -1 before start.

reason.description: Machine-readable reason for the current state, e.g. gate_fail.

holdout.description: Members not in any ring until completion (holdout).

kind.description: emergency when created by a kill switch with no active release.

blockers.description: Problems that would make CreateRelease fail.

cumulativeBps.description: Cumulative share of the hash space, in basis points (1..10000).

version.description: 0 when the ring has nothing to run yet.

counts.description: Counts for members of exactly this ring.

fallbackVersion.description: Version every ring was returned to.

exposed.description: Members that had been sent the candidate.

confirmed.description: Of those, confirmed serving the fallback at the rollback generation.

unreachable.description: Not seen within the reachable window; they reconcile on reconnect.

salt.description: Hash salt. Defaults to "<config>/<environment>". Frozen per release.

pinnedGroups.description: Authenticated group -> ring index. Overrides hashing for that group.

minInstances.description: Minimum members in the first ring and in its control cohort.

acceptanceThreshold.description: Fraction of reachable ring members that must have ACCEPTED.

minReachableFraction.description: Fraction of ring members that must be reachable to evaluate at all.

maxSdkRejections.description: SDK rejections / crash loops tolerated in exposed rings before rollback.

reachableWindow.description: An instance counts as reachable if seen within this window.

identity.description: Identity and roles of the caller, as the server sees them.

v1SignedStatement.description:
SignedStatement is canonical JSON plus an ed25519 signature over
"cfgcanary/<purpose>/v1\n" + payload.

stage.description: Stage that produced it: limits, json, schema, cue, relative, wasm.

jsonSchema.description: JSON Schema (draft 2020-12) document, as JSON text. Optional.

cue.description: CUE constraints unified with the payload. Optional.

baseVersion.description: Version the relative guards were evaluated against; 0 when none.

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the module. Set by the server.

module.description: Module bytes; only on RegisterConfig. Never returned.

memoryLimitMib.description: Linear memory limit in MiB. 0 means the server default.

required.description:
When true, a validator that cannot run rejects the submission. Always
true in v1; present so the policy is explicit in the stored spec.
